text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhhhhaaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I will reach it. —I will reach it. 
For our long-cherished dream. For myself!)

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
...She can do it. She can do it...! 
At this pace... K-Keep goingーーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Go for itーーーー! Take it all the 
wayーーー!! 
Phaleno-saaaanーーーー!!
choice_data_list: Reach itーーーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... haaah, haaah...!! 
That is right... Everyone is counting on 
me...!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—begone. 
Not a single soul shall lay a finger upon 
it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: That crown belongs to me!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Phalaenopsisーーーー! 
Phalaenopsis seizes a brilliant, decisive 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member B
text_block_list.text:
...! She did it...! 
Phaleno-san has done it again...!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuugh... Phaleno-san... 
You're incredible, truly... I have no 
words...

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Aah... Ahh!! 
She conquered the Oka Sho, too...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, but of course.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Are you watching, Trainer? 
Are you watching, my comrades of the Club?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Not only in the previous G1, but here in 
the Oka Sho as well, 
I have achieved this triumph.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Do you know why?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Because you were there 
at my side. And therefore—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I have claimed it.

text_block_list.name: Everyone from the Club
text_block_list.text:
"...Congratulations!" "Congratulations!" 
"Waaah! You did it!" "Phaleno-san!" 
"Uuuugh... My tears are blurring 
everything...!!!"
choice_data_list: Congratulations...! Truly...!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I have answered their 
expectations.

After the race. Together, we all welcome 
back 
Phalaenopsis, who brought yet another 
G1 victory to our Club!

text_block_list.name: Club Members
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you...!" "Thank you so much!" 
"Thank you, Phalaeno-san...!" 
"For winning for us!" "Thank you!!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The gratitude is mine. 
It is all thanks to everyone who placed 
their faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't hold back my tears! 
Knowing just how hard you've worked for 
this, 
Phalaeno-san... Uuuugh...!
choice_data_list: (...I'm truly glad...)

text_block_list.text:
What I did may have been small, but seeing 
the Club members shower Phalaenopsis with 
gratitude, 
I felt that from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Oh, come to think of it. We're 
going to hold 
a celebration party for Phalaeno-san soon, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yep, it's already set up! Originally, it 
was meant 
to celebrate running in a Classic race, 
but... 
we'll have to rename it to a "Victory 
Celebration"!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, things just got busy!! 
Trainer-san, 
we'll let you know the date later!
choice_data_list: Understood!!

text_block_list.text:
And just like that, 
the day of the victory celebration 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Remarkable. To think they would prepare 
such an extravagant celebration for me.
choice_data_list: Yeah! You can really feel everyone's joy!

Yeah! You can really tell how happy 
everyone is!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. It is but one crown, a single 
blossom. 
I have merely brought home the cherry 
blossom that belongs to our Club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So to receive such festivities for that... 
is a touch embarrassing, but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Look, Trainer. 
There are phalaenopsis orchids not just at 
the entrance, but in the hall as well.
choice_data_list: You're right! They're everywhere...

text_block_list.text:
At this celebration, beautiful 
phalaenopsis orchids 
were displayed everywhere in breathtaking 
abundance.
choice_data_list:
The Club members must have prepared them 
for you.

The Club members must have set them up for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
No, we weren't the only ones who prepared 
them. 
So many of them were sent to the Club as 
congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is that so...!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Various racing associates connected 
to our Club sent them to congratulate us 
on this wonderful achievement!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, our office couldn't even fit 
them all! 
So—I'm really glad we could find an 
occasion 
to put them on display like this!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...That is truly a blessing.
choice_data_list:
I think everyone just couldn't help but 
celebrate.

text_block_list.text:
It was a testament to the goodwill of the 
Club and Phalaenopsis, 
as well as proof of just how prestigious 
a title the Oka Sho truly is.
choice_data_list:
That's just how amazing what you achieved 
really is.

text_block_list.text:
Because she is so driven, she won't let 
herself 
get carried away by a single victory, so I 
tell her that. 
That she is allowed to praise herself 
more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......Heh. Is that so. 
...To think it means that much...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Excessive humility would be an insult, 
after all. 
—I shall take pride in it, as is right.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Once again, for arranging such an 
occasion, 
you have my sincere gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To have brought joy to so many people— 
that is what brings me the greatest 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... That's wonderful to hear! 
Well then, would you mind 
giving the toast soon?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I thank you from the bottom of 
my heart 
for taking the time to gather here for my 
sake today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Our Club, and my Trainer— 
have seized an honor worthy of this 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—However, I have not the slightest 
intention of stopping here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This is merely the beginning. 
The first step toward the prosperity of 
our Club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...That said, let us celebrate and make 
merry today. 
For conquering our very first challenge.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: A toast to our beautiful garden.

text_block_list.name: Banquet Guests
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: Oh, someone's in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Once again, Trainer. 
—Well done.
choice_data_list: You too. I always knew you'd pull it off.
Same to you. I knew you could do it.

text_block_list.text:
I was merely stating a fact. After all, 
I had watched Phalaenopsis continuously 
live up to every expectation until now—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *Pant*, *gasp*... One more lap!

Actions speak louder than words—with her 
dedicated effort, 
she grew exactly as I, her Trainer, had 
hoped. 
And she never betrayed the admiration I 
held for her as her disciple.
choice_data_list:
You're an Umamusume worthy of everything 
I've got.

You are an Umamusume worth giving my all 
for.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That pleases me more than any compliment I 
have received today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, that is enough revelry for 
now. 
It is about time we tightened our focus.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer. The Oaks is up next... 
Have you set your sights upon it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I've already got a proposal ready.
Yep. I've already prepared a proposal.

text_block_list.text:
The problem every girl chasing the Triple 
Tiara 
must confront... is the sudden leap in 
distance 
when stepping up from the Oka Sho to the 
Oaks.

The Oka Sho is 1,600 meters on turf. 
By contrast, the Oaks is 2,400 meters— 
a staggering 800 meters longer.
choice_data_list: Naturally, stamina will be essential.

text_block_list.text:
How much stamina can she conserve along 
the way, 
and how much will she have left in the 
tank for the long home stretch?

Stamina training was therefore essential. 
We also needed her to learn pace control, 
which meant 
finding a partner capable of running 
alongside her.
choice_data_list:
I'm still thinking about who that partner 
should be, though.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. 
In that case, how about Hayahide?
choice_data_list: I see! That's a great idea!
I see! That sounds wonderful!

text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide. A veteran who captured 
three GⅠ titles, 
renowned for consistently placing at the 
very top, 
and the elder sister of Narita Brian.

A logical thinker who constantly honed 
herself 
by formulating a 'formula for victory.' 
And having forged her own stamina that 
way—

She triumphed in the Kikuka Sho and the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). 
Though she has since stepped back from the 
front lines, 
her prowess at long distances is 
indisputable.
choice_data_list:
If she's willing to help, she'd be the 
perfect choice.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to sound her out. 
After all, she and I are old 
acquaintances.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. 
I would be glad to help, if I am up to the 
task.
choice_data_list: Thank you! That's a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No need for formalities... Phaleno-kun and 
I go way back. 
Besides, I find myself personally curious 
about you as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you both. 
Phaleno-kun. Trainer.

Our next race would be the Oaks. With Biwa 
Hayahide's help 
in building stamina, we set our sights on 
victory.
